model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%) across multiple lines. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and spans a logarithmic scale from 1 to 1000, with tick labels at 1, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and ranges linearly from 40 to 65, with tick labels at 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, and 65. A blue solid line with circular markers shows a generally increasing trend, starting at approximately 38% at the beginning of the x-axis and reaching about 53% at the end. A purple dashed line with triangular markers begins at roughly 40% and rises to approximately 51% at the final value on the x-axis. A red solid line with diamond markers starts at roughly 44% and increases to approximately 49% at the end of the x-axis. A green solid line with square markers begins at about 50% and increases to approximately 64% at the maximum value on the x-axis. A black solid line with circular markers begins at approximately 42% and rises to approximately 52% at the terminal point of the x-axis.
